comment: The one list of what the launcher does and how far along each part is. README.md and the website are generated from it by scripts/sync-features.py, so they cannot claim more than this file does. Status is one of: available (works in the app today), in-progress (code exists or is being written, not usable in the app yet), planned.

features.title: Liquid Glass panel
features.summary: A real system glass panel, not a blur imitation, with a selection lens that glides between rows.

features.title: Fuzzy search
features.summary: An in-house matcher that understands prefixes, acronyms, camelCase, word order and typos.

features.title: Learns your habits
features.summary: Pick a result twice for a query and it becomes the top hit. Everything it learns stays on your Mac.

features.title: Suggestions before you type
features.summary: Ranks what you are likely to open next from the time of day, the app in front and what you just used.

features.title: Apps and System Settings
features.summary: Open, quit, hide or reveal any app, and jump straight to a System Settings pane.

features.title: Hotkeys, aliases and favorites
features.summary: Give any item a global hotkey or a short alias, and pin favorites to the top.

features.title: Themes
features.summary: Seven built-in themes, including Beam, modeled on the search panel of macOS 27, and Clear, the system's clear glass with no tint. Change tint, clarity, lens style, accent, text size and row height, then save and share the theme as a file. Switching themes works in the launcher; the editor and sharing are not tested in the app yet.

features.title: Action panel
features.summary: Every result has more actions behind Command-K, with their own shortcuts.

features.title: Updates
features.summary: Once you agree, checks GitHub once a day for a new version and offers it. Sparkle installs an update only when you choose to, after checking its signature. A build from source updates with git instead. No release has shipped the updater yet, so it has not run on a Mac.

features.title: File search
features.summary: An own index of file names that answers in milliseconds, with folder browsing. Proven in the launcher over a sample index; indexing your real folders has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Calculator
features.summary: Math, percentages, units, dates and time zones, answered as you type and copied with Return. Currency conversions fetch rates the first time you ask for one.

features.title: Clipboard history
features.summary: Search text, links, images and files you copied, and paste them back.

features.title: Snippets
features.summary: Saved text with placeholders that you find and paste from the launcher. Expanding a keyword as you type in other apps has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Window management
features.summary: Halves, thirds, quarters, centering and moving windows between displays. Proven against simulated windows; moving real windows has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: System commands
features.summary: Sleep, lock, empty the Trash, toggle dark mode, eject disks and more. Proven against simulated services; the real system calls have not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Quicklinks and web search
features.summary: Open sites and searches with a keyword, and fall back to the web when nothing local matches.

features.title: Emoji picker
features.summary: Search emoji and symbols by name and paste them.

features.title: Script commands
features.summary: Run your own scripts from the launcher, with arguments and live output. The commands and their arguments are proven in the launcher; running a real script has not been tested in the app.

features.title: Universal actions
features.summary: Act on the text or files selected in any app. The actions show for results in the launcher; reading the selection in another app has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Dictionary
features.summary: Look up a word with define, check its spelling, and copy or paste the definition. Proven in the launcher with sample entries; the Mac's own dictionaries have not been read in the app yet.

features.title: Calendar and reminders
features.summary: Your day's events, a meeting to join when it is about to start, and new events and reminders from the launcher. Proven with a sample day; reading your real calendars has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Contacts
features.summary: Find a person and call, message, email or FaceTime them. Proven with sample contacts; reading your real contacts has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Browser bookmarks
features.summary: Search the bookmarks of Safari, Chrome, Firefox and other browsers and open them. Proven with sample bookmarks; reading a real browser's files has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Menu items
features.summary: Search and run any menu command of the app in front. Proven with a sample app's menus; reading a real app's menus has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: AI, with your own key
features.summary: Ask questions with Apple's on-device model or a provider you configure. Nothing is sent unless you ask. Proven in the launcher with a simulated model; a real model has not answered yet.

features.title: Shell commands
features.summary: Type > and a command to run it in your login shell and see its output, with a history of past commands. Proven in the launcher against a simulated shell; running a real command has not been tested in the app.

features.title: Notes
features.summary: Quick notes kept as Markdown files that any editor opens: save one from root search, search titles and text, append, pin, tag, rename and paste them. Proven in the launcher on real files in its own folder; a notes folder you choose in Documents or another folder macOS guards has not been read on a Mac yet, and a floating note window is not part of it.

features.title: Color picker
features.summary: Pick a color on screen, keep the colors you use, and convert hex, RGB, HSL, HWB and OKLCH as you type, with WCAG contrast. Conversions, contrast and the history work in the launcher; picking from the screen has not run on a Mac yet.

features.title: Translate
features.summary: Translate typed or selected text with the languages installed on the Mac, on a page or with tr in root search. Translate sends nothing over the network itself. Proven in the launcher with a simulated engine; Apple's Translation framework has not run in the app yet.

features.title: Media controls
features.summary: Play, pause and skip tracks in Music and Spotify, and see what is playing. Proven in the launcher against a simulated player; controlling the real apps has not run on a Mac yet.
